exposure: Allman classification of clavicle fracture (Group I mid third, Group II lateral distal third, Group III medial proximal third)
cohort: 77 newborns with clavicle fractures from a total of 33,480 live births at a single center in Turkey
finding: There was a significant association between brachial plexus palsy and fracture of the medial third of the clavicle (Allman type III).
mod_finding: While mode of delivery was recorded in the study, no findings related to mode of delivery and clavicle fracture location were reported.
